fields.Name: IT125 - Agent Handoff
fields.Description: Deterministic top-level peer-to-peer agent handoff end to end with a scripted TestLLM stand-in (no live model call): AH1 verifies shipped metadata (Sage enableHandoff, Loop PromptParamsSchema defaults, Research Agent discoverability and default preset); AH2 runs IT: Handoff Source + FollowHandoffs into IT: Handoff Target and asserts the source Handoff step (TargetID, HandoffToAgentID, TargetConversationDetailID), the top-level target run (ParentRunID IS NULL, same ConversationID, Standard preset ConfigurationID), and the target ConversationDetail row; AH3 verifies preset precedence (mj.agentMode.<target id> setting selects High Power; user-message @-mention configId selects Fast); AH4 verifies conversation continuity data for sticky routing; AH5 verifies NotDiscoverable and AlreadyInThisTurn refusals write failed Handoff steps and retry inside the caller's loop; AH6 verifies running without handoffChain omits Handoff from the rendered system prompt and turns a scripted Handoff into a Retry.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All six checks (AH1-AH6) pass: shipped metadata matches the handoff contract, FollowHandoffs creates a top-level target run and links the source Handoff step to the target run and detail row, preset precedence honours mention > user setting > agent default, continuity query returns the target's row, refusals record failed Handoff steps and retry in-loop, and non-handoff hosts omit Handoff from the prompt and reject Handoff responses.
